title: Photo gallery on the files folder
name: gallery
prompt: A private photo gallery for my family. Members upload photos (JPEG, PNG, up to 10 MB each) into albums, see thumbnails in a grid and open a photo full size. Store the photos in the app's files folder and the album info in Postgres. Only the uploader or a manager can delete a photo.

answers: Thumbnails can just be the original scaled down in the browser if that is simpler.

edits: Add a caption to each photo, editable by the uploader.
Let members download a whole album as a zip file.
